description: This file defines the class 'TemplateField', which serves as a base class for managing custom field templates within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It provides methods for generating HTML, XTPL, and database field definitions, as well as handling data population from database rows and POST requests.

classes.name: TemplateField
classes.description: A class representing a template for custom fields in SuiteCRM, including methods for HTML generation, database schema generation, and data population.

methods.name: get_html
methods.description: Returns the HTML representation of the field based on the current view context.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple properties of the TemplateField instance based on an input array.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML for editing the field; placeholder for subclasses.

methods.name: get_html_list
methods.description: Returns HTML suitable for listing; defaults to detail HTML.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns HTML for the detail view; placeholder for subclasses.

methods.name: get_html_search
methods.description: Returns HTML for search interface; defaults to edit HTML.

methods.name: get_xtpl
methods.description: Returns an XTPL representation of the field for a given context.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Returns XTPL content for edit view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns XTPL content for list view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns XTPL content for detail view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Returns XTPL content for search view.

methods.name: is_required
methods.description: Determines if the field is marked as required.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Returns the database column type for the field.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns the default value clause for SQL creation.

methods.name: get_db_required
methods.description: Returns the required/not null clause for SQL.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to add the column in an ALTER TABLE statement.

methods.name: get_db_delete_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop the column in an ALTER TABLE statement.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to modify the column in an ALTER TABLE statement.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the array defining field properties for the bean.

methods.name: populateFromRow
methods.description: Populates the TemplateField's properties from a database row array.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates the TemplateField's properties from POST request data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field template object through the DynamicField handler and updates search field definitions if needed.
